title: Default Setup for Product Teams
content:
Note this page is for DevOps team: After kick-off meeting with team and setup has been done as specified below send a welcome mail.

The default DevOps tools setup for a product consists of:

  • A security group in Azure AD that represents the product team. Group will be used access permissions to several tools and platforms including:

    • GitHub

    • Azure

    • Azure DevOps

    • Power BI

  • A GitHub team that is connected to Azure AD security group

  • A number of repositories supplied by the product team

  • At least a development and test environment represented by a non production Azure subscription

  • An Azure DevOps project that is connected to team Azure AD Team security group.

  • 1 App registrations per environment for Entra ID protected resources

  • Service account for pipeline access to some resources

  • Office group for operations related communication
